scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @party-games/server build && pnpm --filter @party-games/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @party-games/server dev" "pnpm --filter @party-games/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @party-games/clocktower test && pnpm --filter @party-games/server test
